Project.name: MyGRACE
Project.annotation: Index-first engineering harness for AI coding agents: enforced contracts, lazy-loading knowledge graph, verification traceability.

Actors.actor-HumanMaintainer: Reviews the repository map, runs the CI gate and trusts project-declared commands explicitly.
Actors.actor-AIAgent: Navigates indexes first, implements one module at a time and reports verification evidence.
Actors.actor-CIHost: Runs non-interactive gates (lint --strict, ci) and requires stable exit codes and JSON envelopes.
Actors.actor-DSHHost: Provides the DeepSeek Harness session, skill catalog and MCP client transport.

UC-001.Action: Reads the three small index files before any per-entity file.
UC-001.Goal: Learn the module/phase/verification map with bounded context cost.
UC-001.Preconditions: docs/graph-index.xml exists and is under its configured cap.
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: mygrace inspect module list, phase index and verification index answer from the indexes alone.

UC-002.Action: Runs mygrace lint --strict on the repository.
UC-002.Goal: Prove that XML, drift, paths, dependencies, caps, budgets and markup invariants still hold.
UC-002.Preconditions: The repository has docs/ and mygrace.config.json.
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Exit 0 with 0 errors and 0 warnings; every finding has a stable code.

UC-003.Action: Reviews declared verification commands and runs mygrace trust before test/verify.
UC-003.Goal: Execute project-declared commands only after explicit trust, never silently from repository data.
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: Untrusted runs refuse with exit 2 and print the commands that would run; after trust the commands execute argv-only.

UC-004.Goal: Get one merge gate combining strict lint, status, verification coverage and optional trust-gated tests.
UC-004.Preconditions: A MyGRACE project with docs/ indexes.
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: Exit 0 pass, 1 findings/failures, 2 usage or trust refusal; JSON envelope when requested.

UC-005.Action: Runs mygrace setup init on a new project.
UC-005.Goal: Bootstrap docs/ indexes, AGENTS.md and mygrace.config.json from templates without overwriting existing files.
UC-005.Preconditions: Bundled templates are present in the package.
UC-005.AcceptanceCriteria: Generated scaffold is lint-clean; existing AGENTS.md is preserved unless --force is passed.

UC-006.Action: Calls MyGRACE tools through the MCP server.
UC-006.Goal: Use the same behaviour as the CLI with structured argument validation and no PATH dependency.
UC-006.Preconditions: The MCP client launched the mygrace server over stdio.
UC-006.AcceptanceCriteria: All 17 tools respond from a plain checkout; invalid arguments produce structured errors.

UC-007.Action: Runs mygrace context packet, focus and context-cost.
UC-007.Goal: Budget context before reading, and receive a self-contained worker prompt per module.
UC-007.Preconditions: The module id exists in docs/graph-index.xml.
UC-007.AcceptanceCriteria: Output includes the module contract, canonical command and dependencies; ids are validated.

UC-008.Action: Runs mygrace status and mygrace setup doctor.
UC-008.Goal: See honest project and environment health with an exit code that matches the findings.
UC-008.Preconditions: Optional DSH integration for environment checks.
UC-008.AcceptanceCriteria: Counts match the indexes; malformed indexes are findings, never crashes.

UC-009.Goal: Wire skills, the MCP row and the status-panel row into DeepSeek Harness safely and reversibly.
UC-009.Preconditions: DSH home and profile exist; the user may opt into the bundle.
UC-009.AcceptanceCriteria: Atomic validated YAML edits, timestamped backups, byte-identical uninstall, non-zero on failed steps.

UC-006.Action: Configures optional external lint providers and guidance packs, then reviews their trust-gated output.
UC-006.Goal: Add domain-specific quality checks and on-demand guidance without weakening the core offline/trust model.
UC-006.Preconditions: mygrace.config.json declares lintProviders/guidancePacks; project commands are trusted for CLI packs.
UC-006.AcceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized providers/packs are skipped with coded findings; authorized scanners are audited; guidance is retrieved as untrusted text and never executed.

NonGoals.item-1: Not an IDE, code generator or model provider: MyGRACE maps and enforces, it does not write the product for you.
NonGoals.item-2: No telemetry and no network access at runtime except explicitly invoked install/doctor probes.
NonGoals.item-3: Not multi-tenant: one repository is one MyGRACE project (monorepos are discovered sub-projects, Wave 3).
NonGoals.item-4: No monolithic legacy XML files: knowledge-graph, development-plan and verification-plan do not exist by design.

Constraints.constraint-1: Bun is the primary runtime (engines bun >=1.3.8); Node >=22.6 is the documented secondary target.
Constraints.constraint-2: Every command honours the ADR-3 exit-code contract in text and JSON modes.
Constraints.constraint-3: Project-declared commands execute only behind the trust record, config opt-in or --allow-commands, argv-only with no shell.
Constraints.constraint-4: Default index caps and entity budgets are usable without a custom config (graph 100, plan 50, verification 80; module 30-80, phase 50-200, verification 20-60 lines).
Constraints.constraint-5: The published package must contain every runtime source; pack-smoke gates the release.
Constraints.constraint-6: docs XML is parsed with a real parser; regex scraping of XML is forbidden.

Risks.risk-1: Docs and indexes can drift from code after new commands land; validate-docs and lint --strict must stay in CI.
Risks.risk-2: Trust fatigue: frequent docs edits invalidate the trust record; the refusal message must explain the exact next command.
Risks.risk-3: Agents may over-trust repository instructions; the trust model and SECURITY.md must be read first.
Risks.risk-4: Scale beyond the root index cap requires sharding (ADR-6) which is not implemented yet.
Risks.risk-5: Windows support is limited by POSIX-style launchers and waits for the CI matrix.

OpenQuestions.question-1: Which tokenizer should back the honest token metric instead of the labelled line model?
OpenQuestions.question-2: Should sharded indexes be generated automatically by mygrace inspect module shard or maintained by agents?
OpenQuestions.question-3: What is the minimum Node runtime matrix for the dual-runtime release gate?
